name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a **large, high-contrast skip link** at the top of every page, visible only to screen reader users and keyboard navigators. This improves navigation efficiency for users who rely on these tools, ensuring they can bypass repetitive content and access the main sections quickly. The trade-off is that it may occupy visual space for sighted users; however, the benefit of enhancing overall accessibility outweighs this concern.

name: Reader
text: The real risk is the skip link becoming a persistent visual element when focused, cluttering the interface for sighted keyboard users. A better alternative is a visually hidden skip link that only appears when tabbed to, using CSS to reveal it without disrupting layout. Settle it by testing with screen readers and keyboard-only users to confirm it doesn’t obscure content or create confusion.
